method: Ranked on the register this app is read against, not on area. Archaeological lokaliteter only - lokalitetskategori = L-ARK on geonorge's Kulturminner WFS, counted per 5 km cell with resultType=hits and weighted by that cell's covered fraction of the footprint union, so the figure is lokaliteter inside the acquisition rather than inside its envelope. README.md records the two traps the raw count walks into.
